title: mcp
description: Free finance and trading calculators as MCP tools: risk/reward, RMD, Coast FIRE, inflation.
summary: Free finance and trading calculators as MCP tools: risk/reward, RMD, Coast FIRE, inflation.
offersHint: Free finance and trading calculators as MCP tools: risk/reward, RMD, Coast FIRE, inflation. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://economicium-mcp.economicium.workers.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: risk_reward
toolsPreview.description: Reward:risk ratio, breakeven win rate, and expectancy in R multiples from an entry, stop and target.

toolsPreview.name: position_size
toolsPreview.description: Lot size, units and per-lot pip value from account risk, a stop distance, and an instrument.

toolsPreview.name: pip_value
toolsPreview.description: Cash value of one pip/point for a given instrument, lot size and account currency.

toolsPreview.name: margin
toolsPreview.description: Notional value, required margin, and effective leverage for a leveraged position.

toolsPreview.name: profit_loss
toolsPreview.description: Cash result, pips, and return-on-margin for a closed or hypothetical trade.

toolsPreview.name: compounding
toolsPreview.description: Account growth curve, total return and the gain from compounding vs. simple interest.

toolsPreview.name: pivot_points
toolsPreview.description: Classic, Fibonacci, Camarilla and Woodie support/resistance levels from a prior high, low and close.

toolsPreview.name: fibonacci_levels
toolsPreview.description: Retracement (0-100%) and extension (127.2-261.8%) price levels for a swing high/low.

toolsPreview.name: liquidation_price
toolsPreview.description: Estimated liquidation price and distance from entry for a leveraged crypto position.

toolsPreview.name: rmd
toolsPreview.description: This year's RMD from a prior-year-end IRA/employer-plan balance and age, per the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table.

toolsPreview.name: ibond_value
toolsPreview.description: Accrued and redeemable value of a Series I savings bond, from its issue month, face value and an as-of month.

toolsPreview.name: financial_health_score
toolsPreview.description: A 0-100 score from savings rate, emergency fund coverage and debt-to-income, each against a named benchmark.

toolsPreview.name: real_wage
toolsPreview.description: Whether a pay change kept pace with inflation, in real (inflation-adjusted) terms, using annual US CPI.

toolsPreview.name: emergency_fund
toolsPreview.description: How many months of runway a set of resources covers against monthly expenses, net of unemployment benefits and COBRA.

toolsPreview.name: coast_fire
toolsPreview.description: The amount invested today that, growing alone with no further contributions, reaches a full FIRE number by retirement age.

toolsPreview.name: inflation_adjust
toolsPreview.description: What a dollar amount in one year is worth in another year's dollars, based on annual US CPI-U.

toolsPreview.name: fx_rate
toolsPreview.description: Daily ECB reference cross rate between two currencies.

toolsPreview.name: cpi_index
toolsPreview.description: The annual (yearly-average) US CPI-U index value for a given year.
